protocol.question: Does persistent capacity-limited zero-target cash closing preserve the small positive short-only result, or did five-attempt expiry materially change profitability and exposure?

labels.classes: SHORT below -37bp; LONG above +37bp; CASH otherwise; missing future stays missing

protocol.adoption: Keep persistent-close capability for execution fidelity regardless of PnL. Retain this short recipe as research only if net positive versus cash in all four conditional scenarios; otherwise pause this recipe. Report paired net/DD/Sharpe/exposure versus D088, never revert to expired closing solely to recover PnL. No investment, bear-alpha or unseen qualification.
protocol.stopping: Only DAILY_TARGET zero quantity retry changes: continue capacity-limited reduce-only fills until closed or superseded by newer decision, risk or terminal. Four new full122day accounts,24 old controls SHA-reused; zero new fits/search. Legacy scheduler is the only allowed source difference with captured-before-change default golden and four actual regressions; other financial/data/state sources exact. Preserve terminal/risk/held-gap halts and all fees/funding.

regime.policy: BEAR allows only original SHORT; all original LONG targets masked to cash; BULL/SIDEWAYS/HIGH_VOL_CRASH cash; never invert, risk reduction active
regime.source: Existing D085/D086 descriptive state definition, zero changed thresholds
